stem: Which principle of universal design is about providing the same means of use for all users?

options.rationale: Provides the same means of use for all users where possible.
Accommodates a wide range of preferences and abilities.
Makes use easy to understand regardless of experience.
Minimizes the consequences of accidental actions.

explanation: Equitable use means the design is useful and marketable to people with diverse abilities and provides the same means of use where possible.
